workflow.title: Review Downloads and developer caches as different cleanup decisions
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide which Downloads files to keep and which developer caches can be rebuilt without treating every large folder as disposable.
workflow.description: Use a preview to separate personal downloads from rebuildable developer data. Compare TrashPanda's documented review tools with Breathing Room's source-backed investigation approach, without promising recovered space.
outline: Start with the keep/rebuild/unknown decision, not a savings figure
Downloads Detox groups files but does not establish disposability
Review named developer caches, rebuild cost and ownership before approving
Distinguish Trash movement from available disk space
Choose a documented offline sweep or a preview investigation with hosted-AI caveats
workflow.visualPlan: After lead: rights-cleared Downloads Detox UI (currently blocked). Later: selected Space browser preview with example-data caption.
workflow.interactionHandoff: Keep / rebuild with cost / investigate checklist. Inputs: personal original, backup, owning tool, regeneration cost. Unknown routes to investigate, never deletion. No filesystem access or fabricated byte savings.
workflow.limits: Not a hands-on review/tutorial. No installer or cleanup was run; source citations adjacent to each product statement. Final title/slug uniqueness and specific tool routes require downstream site review.

comparison.title: TrashPanda vs Breathing Room: offline cleanup or ongoing investigation
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose between documented offline preview-based cleanup and Breathing Room's maintenance preview/source-backed monitoring approach.
comparison.format: Short conclusion, sourced matrix above, bounded recommendations, exact install/pricing caveats, workflow link. Unknown competitor cells stay not verified.
trashpandaAdvantages: Vendor documents offline/no-AI app without activation account; website purchase/re-download is separate.
Advertised one-time $1.99 with lifetime updates, rather than a hosted-care subscription; currency/tax conditions unresolved.
Documents preview, Trash mode, Downloads grouping and adjacent read-only Watchtower auditing.
breathingRoomAdvantages: Source-backed grouped helper monitoring and activity/storage history suit investigations beyond a single cleanup; binary parity remains unverified.
Free local core and Apache-2.0 desktop source, with optional advertised hosted AI Care rather than a required separate app purchase.
tradeoffs: TrashPanda: current line macOS 14+, proprietary terms, manual download flow and historical Intel install caveats; no independent safety/telemetry audit.

Breathing Room: macOS 13+ preview, Python 3.10+, not Developer ID signed/notarized per release, untested physical Intel/clean-machine behavior, hosted AI authentication/data-sharing and optional recurring cost.
No claim that TrashPanda lacks helper monitoring or growth tracking; those are unverified.
Neither product's documented preview guarantees risk-free cleanup, performance improvements or measured savings.
